messages:
Lina (PM): Quick sync about GA gating for predictor-lite. Need clarity on SLA language, canary/rollback automation, week-1 coverage, monitoring (including hallucination/regression signals), promo mechanics, and any contract carve-outs. I want a single owner for the final gate.

Tom (SRE): SLA proposal: 99.9% monthly uptime; p95 <= 130ms; p99 <= 420ms. Operational constraints: canary rollout must be automated with staged percentages (5%, 25%, 100%) and an automatic hold/rollback if any of these hit thresholds: error_rate > 0.8% for 2m, p99 latency > 600ms for 5m, or hallucination_rate > 2% for 10m. We'll implement a circuit-breaker to avoid flip-flopping. I can own infra + rollback automation.

Pri (Docs): Docs status: quickstart, API examples, and SDK snippets done. Open items: runbook with automated-rollback details, a short CS triage one-pager, and a note about hallucination metrics (how we detect and act). Need Tom to confirm the exact automation flags/CLI for docs. I'll draft the CS one-pager once Grace confirms support handoff. PR: https://git.repo/PR/1420

Yasmin (Sales): Sales asks for a targeted launch credit (12% for 60 days) limited to named early adopters and subject to a per-account cap; also want a clear path to reserved pricing (12-month commit). Constraint: Finance requires an exposure cap and upfront tagging of billing codes. I can own promo list + customer comms.

Marco (Finance): Finance OK with promo if total exposure < $75k and each account cap is defined. We'll need a special billing SKU PROMO-LITE-GA-2026. For reserved pricing, we need a signed term sheet template; happy to collaborate with Sales.

Grace (Support): Support readiness: need runbook links in the portal, playbook for prompt regressions (how to triage hallucination vs prompt drift), and CS oncall handoff plan for week-1. Recommend a CS standby for 72 hours. I'll arrange the standby if Pri publishes the playbook.

Nia (Product Ops): Monitoring checklist: must include hallucination_rate by prompt-set, prompt_regression_rate sliding 24h, token_cost_per_request, model_version_error_rate, and canary_e2e_latency. Alerts: P0 page on service down, P1 page on hallucination spikes > 1% for 5m, P2 notify for cost guardrail breaches. Ops-bot can run rolling smoke + hallucination heuristics nightly.

Ops-bot: Scheduled rolling canary smoke + hallucination-check at 01:45 UTC daily. Failures and metric deltas will post to #eng-sre and the release dashboard.

Legal-bot: Reminder: any SLA carve-outs (HIPAA or bespoke uptime) require a signed addendum + DPA. Also flag: avoid absolute language like "continuous availability" in public SLA copy. Legal will prep addendum template on request.

Tom (SRE): Example rollback automation snippet for docs:
```
# staged rollout controller
rwctl rollout start --model predictor-lite:v1 --stages 5,25,100 --auto-hold \
  --hold-if 'error_rate>0.8%:2m,p99>600ms:5m,hallucination_rate>2%:10m' \
  --on-hold 'rwctl rollback --to stable; notify oncall'
```

Pri (Docs): Adding the snippet to PR/1420. Will include a short explanation of the circuit-breaker and a note: "auto-rollback will pause further rollouts for 60m after a triggered rollback unless manually resumed."

Yasmin (Sales): I'll produce the named-customer list and proposed per-account caps today. Will assign billing SKU once Marco confirms the code. Also need product signoff on reserved-pricing term sheet outline.

Marco (Finance): Confirmed we can reserve PROMO-LITE-GA-2026 as a SKU; will add the spend cap controls to billing pipeline. Send the customer list and I will tag accounts.

Grace (Support): CS standby confirmed for 72 hours post-GA. I'll post contact names into the runbook once it's published.

Nia (Product Ops): One operational ask: include a daily estimated token spend alert (P2) so FinOps isn't surprised. Also suggest we expose a per-customer quota guard for the promo to avoid runaway costs.

Tom (SRE): Agree on quotas. We'll add a hard cap per-account for promo period and a soft notify threshold. Also recommending +1 SRE on rotation for first 48h.

Lina (PM): Owners summary: SLA & rollback automation -> Tom; Runbook & docs + CS one-pager -> Pri & Grace; Promo + reserved-pricing -> Yasmin & Marco; Monitoring + alerts -> Nia; Legal addendum -> Legal-bot. I'll own the final gate and publish the checklist doc. Please confirm "green" here when your item is complete. Any last blockers?

Yasmin (Sales): Green for promo plan draft (waiting Finance tagging).

Marco (Finance): Green pending account list; PROMO SKU reserved.

Pri (Docs): Will push runbook + CS one-pager by 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

Tom (SRE): Infra automation + rollback config in staging; will flip to prod config after doc signoff. Assigning extra SRE coverage for 48h. Green from SRE side.

Grace (Support): Green on CS standby prep; will add contacts after runbook published.

Nia (Product Ops): Alerts and smoke scheduled; will post thresholds to checklist doc in 30m. Green.

Legal-bot: Addendum template queued; Legal will review any custom requests. Green.

Lina (PM): Thanks all. I'll publish the checklist and call Ready to Ship when Pri confirms the runbook PR merged and Marco confirms account tagging. :rocket:
